title: Chicken Fricassée
equip: 1 large stainless steel pot or skillet with a lid (stockpot works), 1 plate

items.n: chicken thighs, skin-on and bone-in (about 250 g each)
white or button mushrooms, halved (quartered if large)
medium brown onions, sliced 0.6 cm thick

items.sub: 185 ml evaporated milk, or 120 g plain yogurt stirred in off the heat

steps.x: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Sprinkle with 1 tsp salt and 0.5 tsp pepper.
Melt the butter over medium-high heat in the pot. Add the thighs skin side down and cook 5 min until golden. Flip and cook 1 min, then move to a plate.
Brown the drumsticks in the same pot, about 2 min per side on 3 sides. Move to the plate. Work in batches if the pot is crowded.
Add the mushrooms, onions, bay leaf and thyme to the pot. Cook 5 min until the mushrooms are lightly golden.
Add the garlic and stir 30 sec. Add the flour and cook 1 min, stirring, to cook out the raw taste.
Pour in the wine, stock, 0.25 tsp salt and 0.25 tsp pepper. Scrape the bottom of the pot well to lift the browned bits into the sauce.
Nestle the chicken back in, skin side up, so the skin stays out of the liquid.
Bring to a simmer, then lower the heat so it bubbles steadily but gently. Cover and simmer 10 min.
Remove the lid and simmer 20 min more to reduce the sauce. The chicken should reach 75°C inside.
Move the chicken to a plate. Stir the cream into the sauce and bring back to a simmer. Taste and add salt if needed.
Return the chicken to the sauce, take off the heat and sprinkle with parsley. Serve over rice, mashed potato or short pasta like penne.

notes: Use skin-on, bone-in pieces. Boneless breast dries out. If you must, brown it, reduce the sauce uncovered 15 min, then simmer the breast covered 6 min until it hits 65°C. Boneless thigh is the same but cook to 75°C.
No wine: use extra chicken stock. Any dry white works. Avoid sweet or oaky ones.
The cream is worth keeping here. Use up the leftover Emborg in scrambled eggs, a pasta sauce or a mushroom soup within a few days.
Not spicy, so no child's portion needed.
Meal prep: 8 pieces of chicken makes 4 portions of 2 pieces each, with sauce. Pack with rice or mashed potato.
Storage: fridge up to 3 days in an airtight container. Cream sauces can split when frozen, so freeze only if you must.
Reheat gently on the stove with a splash of water or stock. Don't boil hard.
Fresh thyme and bay leaf are at FairPrice or Sheng Siong. Dried works fine.
